In the `cast` case they run the same calc: the certificate bound, then `Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (hinitial i.castSucc e)`, then `growthRegularityComplexity_eq_factor_mul` closed by `rfl`. The reasoning that propagates a per-layer factor bound from the initial complex is real and appears twice with the same hypotheses. A generic lemma needs only the data already in scope in `nonempty`. The remaining per-variant pieces are small: the `simpa [B, ...]` step and the `bound i.castSucc = factor i * initialBound i.castSucc` identification. This is a single-proof repetition (two goals in one proof), and the very similar single-layer calc in OrderedRemovalAssembly.lean (lines 1060–1091) cannot reuse this lemma because it works on one layer.
claims.shared_lemma: theorem layerComplexity_le_of_factor_bound {G : Type*} [Fintype G] [DecidableEq G] {k r : ℕ} (initial P : OrderedPartitionComplex G k r) (initialBound bound : Fin (r+1) → ℕ) (factor : Fin r → ℕ) (hinitial : ∀ (q : Fin (r+1)) (e : OrderedFace k q.1), FacePartition.complexity (initial.partition q e) ≤ initialBound q) (htop : P.topLayer = initial.topLayer) (hlast : bound (Fin.last r) = initialBound (Fin.last r)) (hcast : ∀ i : Fin r, bound i.castSucc = factor i * initialBound i.castSucc) (hP : ∀ (i : Fin r) (e : OrderedFace k i.1), FacePartition.complexity (P.partition i.castSucc e) ≤ factor i * FacePartition.complexity (initial.partition i.castSucc e)) : ∀ (q : Fin (r+1)) (e : OrderedFace k q.1), FacePartition.complexity (P.partition q e) ≤ bound q. Proof sketch: `intro q; cases q using Fin.lastCases`. In the `last` case, use `congrFun htop e`, unfold `topLayer`, rewrite, and finish with `hlast ▸ hinitial _ e`. In the `cast i` case, use `(hP i e).trans ((Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (hinitial _ e)).trans_eq (hcast i).symm)`.
